---
description: Break an approved spec into ordered, verifiable tasks
---

Use the planning-and-task-breakdown skill (`.github/skills/planning-and-task-breakdown/SKILL.md`).
Read the spec, then break the work into small, independently verifiable tasks, each with acceptance criteria and explicit dependency order. Save to `tasks/plan.md` and `tasks/todo.md`. Write no product code — show the plan and wait for approval.
